method.dataset: Bank-Review (Google Play reviews of Nigerian banks' apps), Federal University Lokoja
method.dataset_note: Reviews were collected by the dataset's authors, not by this project.
method.sample: 1,000 reviews, 2023, UBA, Access Bank and First Bank of Nigeria, seed 20261124; 100 held out for the accuracy check
method.priority_definition: severity points per 100 reviews: share of reviews raising the category times its average severity (1 to 3) times 100

app_stability.name: App won't open after latest update
app_stability.description: Customers report the app refuses to open, shows a white screen or spins forever, often right after an update or reinstall.

app_stability.name: Crashes or exits during transactions
app_stability.description: App closes, logs out or hangs mid-transaction, such as at PIN entry, payment, transfer or description entry.

app_stability.name: Network errors and no connection in app
app_stability.description: App reports poor, weak or unavailable network, blocking login, registration or account access while other apps work.

app_stability.name: Slow and laggy app performance
app_stability.description: Customers find the app slow to load, lagging or delayed, often saying a recent version is slower than before.

app_stability.name: Update problems and lost data
app_stability.description: After updating, accounts or beneficiaries vanish, updates loop or are unavailable, or version notices conflict with the store.

app_stability.name: Device-specific, install and setup failures
app_stability.description: App cannot be downloaded, installed or set up on certain phones, or fails at PIN or consent setup.

login_access.name: Login fails after update or with errors
login_access.description: Customers cannot log in, especially after an update, due to crashes, blank screens, errors, slow loading or rejected credentials.

login_access.name: Cannot create or use transaction PIN
login_access.description: Customers fail to create, set, reset or use a transaction/mobile PIN, with errors, invalid-PIN messages or missing forgot-PIN options.

login_access.name: New phone: OTP or device activation fails
login_access.description: After changing phones, customers cannot activate or re-register the device because OTP is not sent, card verification fails or the device is not found.

login_access.name: Registration and sign-up fails
login_access.description: New users cannot register or create an account due to crashes, network errors, account-exists or account-number errors, or card requirements.

login_access.name: Device limit or device already exists
login_access.description: Activation or login is blocked by maximum device limit, device-exists messages, or repeated activation prompts.

login_access.name: Rooted, jailbroken or developer-mode blocks
login_access.description: The app refuses to run, claiming the device is rooted, jailbroken, an emulator or has USB debugging enabled.

transfers_payments.name: Other-bank transfers fail or blank after update
transfers_payments.description: Transfers to other banks fail, show blank lists or endless blank pages, especially since the recent app update.

transfers_payments.name: App crashes, hangs or logs out during transactions
transfers_payments.description: The app freezes, exits, logs out or will not open when customers start or authorise a transaction, such as at PIN entry.

transfers_payments.name: Debited but transfer failed or not credited
transfers_payments.description: Money is deducted from the sender for failed or pending transactions, with no credit to the recipient and slow or missing reversals.

transfers_payments.name: Debit account selector blank, blocking transfers
transfers_payments.description: Customers see an empty debit account field or blank page when starting a transaction, so they cannot pick an account or transfer.

transfers_payments.name: Transfer and daily limit confusion or reduction
transfers_payments.description: Customers hit unexplained transfer limits, a reduced 1 million daily cap, or a limit upgrade option that is unavailable.

transfers_payments.name: Beneficiaries missing or cannot be confirmed
transfers_payments.description: Saved beneficiaries do not show, and adding or confirming beneficiaries fails or restarts the flow.

money_balance.name: Failed transfers debited but not reversed
money_balance.description: Transfers, purchases or bill payments fail or go undelivered yet the sender is debited without timely reversal.

money_balance.name: Transaction history missing or limited
money_balance.description: Customers cannot view, scroll or filter past transactions, with history capped or disappearing.

money_balance.name: Balance not visible after app update
money_balance.description: After the new version, balance or accounts are blank or missing, blocking transactions.

money_balance.name: Unauthorized or unexplained debits and charges
money_balance.description: Customers report money removed without their knowledge, unexpected charges or repeated deductions.

money_balance.name: Incoming money not credited
money_balance.description: Transfers or disbursements sent to the customer have not arrived in their account.

money_balance.name: Receipts wrong, missing or undownloadable
money_balance.description: Receipts cannot be downloaded or show wrong dates, and old receipts are hard to get.

ui_ux.name: Dislike new interface, want old version
ui_ux.description: Customers find the redesigned app worse, complex or not user friendly and ask for a fix or the previous version.

ui_ux.name: Transfers and transactions fail after update
ui_ux.description: Since the update, customers cannot complete transfers, other-bank transfers or payments, or the transfer screen fails to open.

ui_ux.name: Slow, crashing or won't open or log in
ui_ux.description: The app lags, crashes, shows blank screens or errors, or fails to open or log in after updates.

ui_ux.name: Update prompts, T&C and login friction
ui_ux.description: Repeated terms prompts, extra OTP steps, device or card login limits and confusing update notices annoy customers.

ui_ux.name: Receipts and history missing or incomplete
ui_ux.description: Receipts cannot be downloaded, are inaccurate or are unavailable for past transfers, and history is limited or lacks detail.

ui_ux.name: Account balance or accounts not displayed
ui_ux.description: After updating, balances are unavailable or accounts and debit selectors show blank or wrong, blocking transactions.
